text:
Maria P: FYI - new contractor Amal K's I-9 hit a snag. Passport expires in 2 weeks; background vendor flagged missing alias match. We have virtual day-1 on Mon 3/4 9am PT but Amal says that slot doesn't work. Need notary + benefits/workaround.

Samir: thanks. Can Amal upload a scanned passport + selfie now? If passport is expiring we can accept other docs but will still need a notary for the physical I-9. What timezone is Amal in?

Maria P: Amal is in CET (Berlin). Passport expiry 2024-03-20. They can do a notary next Tue afternoon CET. Also asked whether benefits/stipend enrollment can be extended for contractors.

Nicole (Benefits): quick note — contractors aren't eligible for medical but do get prorated commuter/meal stipend enrollment. Standard window is 14 days from start. We can make a one-time 48h extension with a manager OK. I'll sign off if hiring manager confirms new start date + docs. :white_check_mark:

Samir: hiring manager (Liam) said start was 3/4 but we can shift to 3/6. @Ben - if we move orientation, can you still do remote badge + laptop ship so Amal can join on day 1?

Ben - IT: yep. I can do express ship if we lock address. Please paste address + phone. I put the laptop on hold under ticket `#3456`.

CourierBot: Shipment label created: TRACK12345. ETA 2024-03-05. Carrier: FastShip.

Maria P: tagging Liam — @Liam can you confirm 3/6 is OK and approve the 48h stipend extension? :pray:

Liam (Eng Manager): OK 3/6 works for us. I approve the stipend extension.

Nicole (Benefits): extension approved. Amal, you'll receive an email with the stipend sign-up link — please complete within 48h of the new start.

Samir: plan (TL;DR):

```
Day-1 orientation: 2024-03-06 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET
Notary I-9 (video-assisted + local notary): 2024-03-07 15:00 CET
Laptop ETA (express): 2024-03-05
Required uploads: passport scan + selfie by EOD 2024-03-04
```

Maria P: thanks all. I'll DM Amal the checklist, update the calendar invite, and confirm courier tracking. :thumbsup:

Amal K (new-hire): Thanks everyone — confirmed 3/6 and will upload passport tonight. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
